W = m·g / 6 (equal static share, level ground). Rigid-wheel chord at sinkage z: l = 2√(D·z − z²); A = b·l; p = W / A. Both inputs are adjustable demo assumptions, not measured soil limits; ≥ 90% of the limit is flagged as near.

Body is the imported 3D model (4272 × 2040 mm at 2700 span); its length stretches as 4272 mm + (span − 2700). Track is measured between wheel centers. Clearance is the smallest vertical gap from the model underside (405 mm above the mean axle) to the DTM surface, sampled every 1 m along the planned route.

In My model mode each 1 m cell draws a predicted class from its true class's row of the matrix. Errors are spatially correlated at about 7 m, so a rock cluster tends to be detected or missed as a whole. Missed rocks take the color of the predicted ground class and the planner drives through them.
